## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or relevant backlog item.

## Validation

List checks actually run, with locale/RTL, browser/accessibility and authorization evidence appropriate to the change.

## Dependencies and review

Record missing approved assets/content, external configuration and material risks. Include screenshots for visual changes; keep private data out.

- [ ] No secrets, private references or real personal data committed.
- [ ] Public output respects publication and translation eligibility.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior.
